Hello. I am David. Lean got my interest for a while now. Learning on how to contribute here, and also trying new things like formalise - for example some simple combinatorics and number theory books.

Some topics are really hard to formalise it seems, and first i need to deepen my knowledge of Lean proving so i tackle those hard subjects.
Will showcase the project repos later, because they still lack a proper foundation.
Happy to be here.
